_meta.description: Declarative allowlist of extra CLI security tools the fireteam can invoke via run_external_tool. Add a tool here (no code change) to widen the arsenal. Only tools listed here are runnable; argv is built as a list (never a shell string) and the target is scope-checked by the guardrail layer.
_meta.placeholders: {target} is replaced by the validated target; operator-supplied extra_args are shlex-split, metachar-filtered, and appended (or substituted at {extra}).

dalfox.description: Advanced XSS scanner — reflected/DOM/stored, parameter mining, WAF-aware payloads. Complements probe_xss_reflection with deeper param analysis.

kxss.description: Fast reflected-parameter finder — reports which parameters reflect unfiltered special characters (XSS candidates). Feed URLs on stdin via extra, or a single {target}.

crlfuzz.description: CRLF injection scanner (HTTP response splitting / header injection) — a class not covered by the built-in hunters.

ffuf.description: Fast web fuzzer — content/parameter/vhost discovery. Use FUZZ keyword in {target} and pass -w wordlist via extra_args.

sstimap.description: Server-Side Template Injection detection and exploitation across many engines (Jinja2, Twig, Freemarker, etc.).

commix.description: Command-injection detection and exploitation. High risk — confirm scope before running.
